title: NRF-2/HO-1 Pathway-Mediated SHOX2 Activation Is a Key Switch for Heart Rate Acceleration by Yixin-Fumai Granules.
authors: Zhang, Heng; Chen, Chen; Liu, Yue; Ren, Lu; Qi, Jing; Yang, Yang; Chen, Wei; Yao, Yingjia; Cai, Xintong; Liu, Zhuang; Hao, Miao; Li, Lingkang; Deng, Zisu; Sun, Mingyu; Lu, Yongping; Chen, Keyan; Hou, Ping
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过NRF-2/HO-1通路激活SHOX2调控钙通道改善窦房结功能，虽含分子对接但核心为细胞与动物实验，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: Population aging has led to increased sick sinus syndrome (SSS) incidence; however, no effective and safe medical therapy has been reported thus far. Yixin-Fumai granules (YXFMs), a Chinese medicine granule designed for bradyarrhythmia treatment, can effectively increase SSS patients' heart rate. Senescence-induced sinoatrial node (SAN) degeneration is an important part of SSS pathogenesis, and older people often show high levels of oxidative stress; reactive oxygen species (ROS) accumulation in the SAN causes abnormal SAN pacing or conduction functions. The current study observed the protective effects of YXFMs on senescent SAN and explored the relationship between the NRF-2/HO-1 pathway, SHOX2, and T-type calcium channels. We selected naturally senescent C57BL/6 mice with bradycardia to simulate SSS; electrocardiography, Masson's trichrome staining, and DHE staining were used to assess SAN function and tissue damage. Immunofluorescence staining and Western blotting were used to assay related proteins. In vitro, we treated human-induced pluripotent stem cell-derived atrial myocytes (hiPSC-AMs) and mouse atrial myocyte-derived cell line HL-1 with D-galactose to simulate senescent SAN-pacemaker cells. CardioExcyte96 was used to evaluate the pulsatile function of the hiPSC-AMs, and the mechanism was verified by DCFH-DA, immunofluorescence staining, RT-qPCR, and Western blotting. The results demonstrated that YXFMs effectively inhibited senescence-induced SAN hypofunction, and this effect possibly originated from scavenging of ROS and promotion of NRF-2, SHOX2, and T-type calcium channel expression. In vitro experiment results indicated that ML385, si-SHOX2, LDN193189, and Mibefradil reversed YXFMs' effects. Moreover, we, for the first time, found that ROS accumulation may hinder SHOX2 expression; YXFMs can activate SHOX2 through the NRF-2/HO-1 pathway-mediated ROS scavenging and then regulate CACNA1G through the SHOX2/BMP4/GATA4/NKX2-5 axis, improve T-type calcium channel function, and ameliorate the SAN dysfunction. Finally, through network pharmacology and molecular docking, we screened for the most stable YXFMs compound that docks to NRF-2, laying the foundation for future studies.
abstract_zh: 人口老龄化导致病态窦房结综合征（SSS）发病率上升；然而，迄今为止尚无有效且安全的药物治疗方法。益心复脉颗粒（YXFMs），一种专为缓慢性心律失常治疗设计的中药颗粒，能有效提高SSS患者的心率。衰老诱导的窦房结（SAN）退行性变是SSS发病机制的重要组成部分，老年人常表现出高水平的氧化应激；SAN中活性氧（ROS）积累导致SAN起搏或传导功能异常。本研究观察了YXFMs对衰老SAN的保护作用，并探讨了NRF-2/HO-1通路、SHOX2和T型钙通道之间的关系。我们选用自然衰老的C57BL/6小鼠伴心动过缓来模拟SSS；采用心电图、Masson三色染色和DHE染色评估SAN功能和组织损伤。免疫荧光染色和Western blotting用于检测相关蛋白。体外实验中，我们用D-半乳糖处理人诱导多能干细胞来源的心房肌细胞（hiPSC-AMs）和小鼠心房肌细胞来源的细胞系HL-1，以模拟衰老的SAN起搏细胞。使用CardioExcyte96评估hiPSC-AMs的搏动功能，并通过DCFH-DA、免疫荧光染色、RT-qPCR和Western blotting验证机制。结果表明，YXFMs有效抑制衰老诱导的SAN功能减退，这一效应可能源于清除ROS并促进NRF-2、SHOX2和T型钙通道表达。体外实验结果显示，ML385、si-SHOX2、LDN193189和Mibefradil逆转了YXFMs的作用。此外，我们首次发现ROS积累可能阻碍SHOX2表达；YXFMs可通过NRF-2/HO-1通路介导的ROS清除激活SHOX2，进而通过SHOX2/BMP4/GATA4/NKX2-5轴调节CACNA1G，改善T型钙通道功能，并缓解SAN功能障碍。最后，通过网络药理学和分子对接，我们筛选出与NRF-2结合最稳定的YXFMs化合物，为未来研究奠定基础。
